title: Kissed with Yeast Irish Sausage Lasagna
description: A comforting and unique twist on traditional lasagna, featuring Irish sausage and a hint of pineapple juice.
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, cook the Irish sausage links over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the cooked sausage from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the olive oil and sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the pineapple juice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the cooked sausage to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, combine the yeast, salt, and 1 tablespoon of warm water to activate the yeast.
Once the yeast is activated, add the yeast mixture to the skillet with the sausage and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked lasagna noodles, the sausage and onion mixture, and the mozzarella and Parmesan cheese.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
